title: Report: Jimmy Garoppolo open to playing after considering retirement

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Jimmy Garoppolo open to playing after considering retirement
sources.description: Free agent quarterback Jimmy Garoppolo considered retirement during the offseason, but Garoppolo has now decided he will come back to play in the right situation, Mike Garafolo of NFL Media reports.
